reviews.title: Unexpected / Unintended charges reversed
reviews.text: I downloaded Nebula as a trial, to see if it was something of interest to me. I decided not to proceed and deleted the account and app. Later I realised I'd been charged for 1 month. I contacted Nebula using their 'chat' feature and their agent responded very quickly to resolve the issue. 4 stars simply for their rapid handling and resolution of that. Thx.

reviews.title: Very annoyed
reviews.text: Keep getting charged for this even though I cancelled it months ago , contacted them by e mail, even thought they have a “contact us” on the site u actually can’t contact them, I had to go looking for where to contact them because the subscription wasn’t on my google account so I couldn’t cancel it and I couldn’t find anywhere on the app to cancel, funny how it’s so easy to sign up but near impossible to cancel, I got an e mail back saying they had cancelled, yet I got another charge of €45 a month later. Very annoying and stressful you have to keep watching to make sure they don’t keep charging you, of course they will come up with some excuse that I ordered from them but I did not I deleted my account and cancelled with them. And I was right!!! They did come up with an excuse that when I cancelled in August, a final payment had to be taken in Sept!! Funny how they couldn’t tell me that in August !!! When in fact I had cancelled months b4 August myself but yet ID DID NOT CANCAL!!! Be very careful with this app, I’d pay with a disposable card with little or no money in so they can’t take ur money if u decided u had enough.
reviews.reply:
Hello Nebula User,

We sincerely apologize for the frustration and inconvenience you've experienced. We take your concerns very seriously and would like to address them directly.

First and foremost, we want to assure you that we never intend to charge customers for services they've cancelled. We understand the stress this situation has caused, and we're committed to resolving it promptly.

We'd like to clarify a few points that might help explain the situation:

• Web subscriptions are not displayed in or cancellable through the Apple Store or Google Play Market. They must be managed directly through our platform.
• Pre-authorized online payments often occur in two stages. For example, a payment authorized on August 30 might not be finalized until September 4. This can sometimes lead to confusion about when a cancellation takes effect.
• In some cases, a final payment may be processed after cancellation due to the billing cycle. We apologize if this wasn't clearly communicated.

We'd like to investigate your specific case and ensure that all charges after your cancellation are refunded. Please contact us directly at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com with your account details, and we'll resolve this issue immediately.

We're constantly working to improve our cancellation process and communication. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us enhance our service for all users.
Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We're committed to making this right and regaining your trust.

Sincerely,
The Nebula Support Team 🔮
